Bhaiya's Teachings — Knowledge Base (Session 14)
Topic: The Three Conditions of Mantra — What Must Be True Before a Mantra Actually Works

Source: A short Ashaeiynn Foundation training video (video transcript, ~9.5 min) — a dir ect instructional module rather than a live satsang Q&A. Introduces the three prerequisite conditions ("Condition of Mantras") that determine whether a mantra jaap actually activates. Purpose: Chatbot knowledge — English version. Note: this session is a straight training monologue with no sangat back-and-forth or side conversation — ther e is no separate curated conversational supplement for this session (see note at the end of this document).
1. WHY THIS TOPIC MATTERS

At Ashaeiynn Foundation, the core method used to awaken drishti (spiritual sight) works through the mantra as the seed (beej): the mantra opens the body's chakras, which awakens kundalini shakti, which in turn awakens drishti. Mantra shakti is also the foundation for every advanced vidya taught later — including protective understanding of maaran, uchchatan, stambhan, bhedan, and videshan

(ﬁve classical "guna vidyas"/oﬀensive-defensive sciences named e xplicitly in this session). Learners will eventually be taught how to understand, scientiﬁcally judge, and defend against each of these — but the actual capacity to handle any of them always runs through mantra shakti. Because of this, understanding when a mantra actually works — and when it doesn't — is foundational, and depends on a small number of prerequisite conditions, not on repetition count alone.
2. THE THREE CORE CONDITIONS

A mantra works — not just 100%, but described as "1000%" — only once three speciﬁc conditions are fulﬁlled. If even one is missing, the mantra will not properly activate, regardless of how sincerely or how often it is chanted.
3. CONDITION ONE — A CLEAN AURA (PHYSICAL AND ASTRAL)

Both the physical body's aura and the astral body's aura must be clean — free of "malinta" (impurity). When viewed through drishti, this impurity shows up as black spots on a person's astral body/aura — directly comparable to the dust and grime that accumulates on physical clothing over the course of an ordinary day out in the world. The astral body accumulates its own equivalent of this daily "dirt." Practical steps mentioned: keep the physical body clean, neat, and tidy; Gangajal can be used; various other aura-cleansing methods exist. Ashaeiynn's own speciﬁc cleansing method is reserved for later, more detailed teaching — but the key point for now is simply knowing that aura cleanliness is a genuine prerequisite, not an incidental nicety.
4. CONDITION TWO — GENUINE PROTECTION (RAKSHASURAKSHA) MUST BE IN PLACE

Someone or something — a person, a devta, a Guru — must be actively protecting the practitioner. This condition matters for a precise mechanical reason, not just as general reassurance. As soon as a person begins mantra jaap, energy starts forming in their body. This forming energy attracts outside attention — from both negative and positive sources alike, drawn simply by the visible buildup of energy. Whatever is drawn — negative or positive — will typically try to tak e/absorb that newly forming energy for itself. If this happens unchecked, the energy never settles and accumulates within the practitioner's own body.

If the energy doesn't settle in the body, the mantra shakti cannot rise upward — creating exactly the "loophole" that causes people to conclude, understandably but inaccurately, that "the mantra just isn't working." Real, active protection is what prevents this energy from being drawn away before it can settle and build.
5. CONDITION THREE, PART A — NO TANTRA-MANTRA-YANTRA (BLACK MAGIC) BEING DONE ON THE PRACTITIONER

No third-party tantra-mantra-yantra kriya, or black magic, should be active against the person doing the jaap. If a negativity is attached through black magic, it will actively try to absorb whatever mantra energy the person generates — and then use that very same absorbed energy to further suppress and oppress the practitioner. This is the real mechanism behind a speciﬁc, otherwise-confusing pattern: some people under black magic feel MORE tired, MORE unwell, and MORE distressed speciﬁcally when they pray or worship more intensely — because their own generated energy is being redirected straight into strengthening what's suppressing them, rather than building up their own reserves.
6. CONDITION THREE, PART B — NO PITRU INTERFERENCE

A pitru is precisely deﬁned: a deceased member of one's OWN family — someone no longer in a physical body, but who still exists in the astral world. They are called "pitru" speciﬁcally because they belong to the practitioner's own family lineage — this is not a generic bhoot/pret, but one tied by blood/family connection. No pitru should be present in the practitioner's aura mandal (aura zone) or actively obstructing them — if one is, the practitioner's mantra will not work, and their drishti will not open. Why this happens, mechanically: when a family member dies and releases from the body, they come to realize that, in a deeper sense, "no one was truly their own" — and in response, they try to draw energy speciﬁcally fr om their own surviving family, in order to rise/ascend further in the astral world. This impulse is described as understandable, even sympathetic, in some respects ("achha bhi hai kai factors mein") — but it is simultaneously suppressive for the living family member: the pitru absorbs the mantra energy that the practitioner is generating, so it never accumulates in the practitioner's own body, holding back their drishti awakening — sometimes for decades. Illustrative case cited: people who had done jaap continuously for 50–60 years with no perceptible result — but after coming to Ashaeiynn and (implicitly) having pitru interference addressed, their drishti opened within about six months. The jaap itself hadn't failed — it
simply hadn't been able to "stick," because a pitru was continuously absorbing the generated energy.
7. WHAT HAPPENS WHEN ALL THREE CONDITIONS ARE MET

If a person's aura is clean, genuine protection is in place, and they are free of both tantra-mantra-yantra interference and pitru interference, nothing can hold that person back. Through that same mantra, they can reach any corner of the universe and can attain even vidyas (bodies of knowledge) that have been lost to time or have not yet emerged — the mantra becomes a fully open channel once these three blockers are cleared.
8. WHAT COMES NEXT

Future teaching sessions will take each of these three blockers (aura malinta, lack of protection, tantra-mantra-yantra/pitru interference) one at a time, covering: why and how each one speciﬁcally aﬀects a practitioner, how to guar d against it in advance, and how to recover from it if it has already taken hold.
QUICK RULES SUMMARY

1. A mantra activates fully only when three speciﬁc conditions ar e met — not from repetition count alone. 2. Condition 1: both physical and astral aura must be clean; astral impurity shows as black spots through drishti, comparable to ordinary daily physical grime. 3. Condition 2: genuine protection (a person, devta, or Guru) must be active — because jaapgenerated energy attracts outside attention (both negative and positive), and without protection this energy gets drawn away before it can settle and rise as mantra shakti. 4. Condition 3a: no third-party tantra-mantra-yantra/black magic should be active against the practitioner — otherwise generated energy is absorbed and turned back to further suppress them (explaining why some victims feel worse the more they pray). 5. Condition 3b: no pitru (a deceased family member still existing in the astral world) should be present in the practitioner's aura mandal — pitrus absorb generated mantra energy to aid their own ascent, which can block a practitioner's drishti for decades even with decades of sincere jaap. 6. Once all three conditions are fulﬁlled, the mantra works completely — capable of r eaching any corner of the universe and unlocking even lost or future vidyas. 7. Future sessions will cover each blocker (malinta, lack of protection, tantra-mantra-yantra, pitru interference) individually — cause, safeguard, and recovery.

Bhaiya's Teachings — Q&A Pairs (Session 14, English)
The Three Conditions of Mantra
User-style questions with answers grounded in this Ashaeiynn Foundation training module. Greeting style: "Jai Siya Ram."

Q1. I chant my mantra regularly but don't feel like it's "working" — why not? A: Jai Siya Ram! A mantra doesn't activate from sincerity or repetition alone — it requires three speciﬁc prerequisite conditions to be fulﬁlled: a clean aura (physical and astral), genuine pr otection in place, and freedom from both third-party tantra-mantra-yantra interference and pitru interference. If even one condition is missing, the mantra won't properly rise and activate, no matter how devotedly it's practiced.

Q2. What does "aura cleanliness" actually mean, and how would I even know if mine isn't clean? A: It means both your physical body's aura AND your astral body's aura need to be free of "malinta" (impurity). Through drishti, this impurity shows up as black spots on the astral body — directly comparable to how physical clothing picks up dust and grime just from an ordinary day out in the world. The astral body accumulates its own version of that daily buildup. Keeping the physical body clean and tidy, using Gangajal, and other aura-cleansing methods all help; a more speciﬁc Ashaeiynn method will be taught in mor e depth later.

Q3. Why does the mantra need someone protecting me — isn't the mantra itself supposed to protect me? A: The mechanism runs the other way at ﬁrst. As soon as you begin mantra jaap, energy starts forming in your body — and that forming energy draws outside attention, both negative and positive. Whatever gets drawn in will typically try to absorb that newly forming energy for itself. Without active protection (a person, devta, or Guru), that energy gets pulled away before it can settle and accumulate in your body — and if it never settles, mantra shakti can't rise upward. That's the real "loophole" behind a mantra that seems not to be working.

Q4. How would black magic speciﬁcally stop my mantra from working? A: If a negativity is attached to you through third-party tantra-mantra-yantra practice, it will actively try to absorb whatever mantra energy you generate — and then use that very energy to further suppress and oppress you. This is exactly why some people under black magic feel MORE tired, MORE unwell, and MORE distressed speciﬁcally when they pray or worship mor e — their own generated energy
is being redirected straight into what's suppressing them, instead of building up their own reserves.

Q5. What exactly is a "pitru," and how is it diﬀerent from an ordinary bhoot or pret? A: A pitru is speciﬁcally a deceased member of your OWN family — someone no longer in a physical body, but who still exists in the astral world, tied to you by blood/family lineage. That family connection is exactly why they're called "pitru" rather than a generic negativity.

Q6. Why would my own deceased family member want to block my spiritual progress? A: It's not necessarily malicious in intent. When a family member dies and releases from the body, they come to realize that, in a deeper sense, no one was truly "their own" — and in response, they try to draw energy speciﬁcally fr om their surviving family in order to rise/ascend further in the astral world. This impulse is described as understandable, even sympathetic in some respects. The problem is that it's simultaneously suppressive for the living family member: the pitru absorbs the mantra energy you're generating, so it never accumulates in your own body, holding back your drishti awakening — sometimes for decades.

Q7. I've heard of people doing jaap for decades with no real result, then suddenly progressing quickly somewhere else. Why? A: This is a documented pattern in the session: people who had done continuous jaap for 50–60 years with no per ceptible change, but whose drishti opened within about six months at Ashaeiynn. The jaap itself hadn't failed — it simply couldn't "stick," because a pitru was continuously absorbing the generated energy. Once that interference is addressed, the same practice can ﬁnally tak e hold.

Q8. If I meet all three conditions, what can my mantra actually do for me? A: Once your aura is clean, genuine protection is active, and you're free of both tantra-mantra-yantra and pitru interference, nothing holds you back — through that same mantra, you can reach any corner of the universe, and can even attain vidyas (bodies of knowledge) that have been lost to time or have not yet emerged. The mantra becomes a fully open channel once these three blockers are cleared.

Q9. Is this connected to the advanced practices like maaran, uchchatan, or stambhan I've heard about? A: Yes — mantra shakti is the foundation underneath all of these. Ashaeiynn Foundation's training path eventually covers protective, scientiﬁc understanding of maaran, uchchatan, stambhan, bhedan, and videshan — but a practitioner's actual capacity to understand, judge, and defend against any of these always runs through their own mantra shakti. That's why establishing these three basic conditions comes ﬁrst, befor e any of the more advanced material.

Q10. What's coming in future training on this topic? A: Each of the three blockers — aura malinta, lack of protection, and tantra-mantra-yantra/pitru interference — will be covered individually in upcoming sessions: why and how each one speciﬁcally aﬀects a practitioner, how to guard against it in advance, and how to recover from it if it has already taken hold.
Bot Response Guidelines (Session 14 additions)

When a user says their mantra/jaap "isn't working," don't default to "chant more" — walk through the three conditions (clean aura, active protection, freedom from tantra-mantrayantra and pitru interference) as the actual diagnostic framework before suggesting anything else. When explaining pitru interference, keep the tone sympathetic toward the deceased family member's underlying motive (their own post-death realization and need to ascend) while still being clear about the real, suppressive eﬀect on the living practitioner — avoid framing pitrus as purely malicious. If a user discloses they feel worse speciﬁcally when they pray or worship mor e, treat this as a potential black-magic/tantra-mantra-yantra interference signal per this session's teaching, and suggest proper screening rather than more intense personal practice alone. Do not overpromise speciﬁcs on aura-cleansing methods beyond what's been taught — acknowledge that Ashaeiynn's speciﬁc method is cover ed in more advanced/later material, while giving the general practical steps (physical cleanliness, Gangajal, general auracleansing awareness) available now. When users ask about advanced practices (maaran, uchchatan, stambhan, bhedan, videshan), note that these are taught later in the Ashaeiynn Foundation path and always root back to mantra shakti and these three foundational conditions — don't provide operational detail beyond what any given session has actually covered. Spelling note: the institute's name is written "Ashaeiynn" — use this spelling consistently.
